about:
TTM Technologies Denver operates from Littleton, Colorado. The business was founded in 1998 and has grown into a global manufacturer with approximately 19,000 employees worldwide. No specific ownership structure or founding individuals are disclosed in the available information.

The company produces mission systems, radio frequency (RF) components, RF microwave and microelectronic assemblies, and technologically advanced interconnect products including printed circuit boards (PCBs) and substrates. Its capabilities span PCB manufacturing, RF component fabrication, microwave assembly, and substrate production at a global scale.

TTM serves the aerospace and defense sector, including space applications. Its customer base includes organizations requiring mission-critical electronics such as aerospace and defense OEMs, with specific offerings in custom assemblies, microelectronics, and engineered solutions for those markets.

The company positions itself around advanced technology products for mission-critical applications, emphasizing its role as a supplier of high-reliability interconnects and RF solutions for demanding environments.
